title: Must-see tour
text:
We were fascinated by the tour; in 4 hours we were able to see the most important parts of the 3 neighborhoods, the Ramblas, Passeig de Gràcia, the Palau de la Música, and the old hospital.
It is a strenuous tour because it lasts 4 hours on foot, but it is definitely worth it, and I recommend it 100% because you can see all the Catalan culture.
Additionally, María makes the tour enjoyable and gives us time for breaks whenever we ask for them.
The lovely María made a reservation for us at a typical Catalan restaurant where the food was delicious.

title: Gràcies Maria!

title: Super recommend!
text:
I did a tour of Barcelona a few days ago with Mane and the truth is that it exceeded all my expectations. From the very first moment you noticed the passion and knowledge about the city, which not only explained the history, but made it feel alive with anecdotes and details that you usually do not find on the internet.
The tour was very well organized, combining the most emblematic points with lesser known corners that ended up being the best of the experience. Plus, the pace was perfect: neither rushed nor heavy, with enough time to enjoy each stop.
